Function: Output file; supports a ".gz" suffix ("-" for stdout).
Number of CPU cores to use.
Comment: The value should be >= the number of seed chunk files (“chunks” in info.toml, set by `-c/--chunks` in `lexicmap index`).

Function: Output more columns, e.g., matched sequences.
Comment: Use this if you want to output blast-style format with "lexicmap utils 2blast"

Function: Keep the top N genome matches for a query in the chaining phase, including all matches tied at the cutoff score
Comment: The number of retained candidates may exceed N when scores are tied. Value 1 is not recommended as the best chaining result does not always yield the best alignment, so it should be >= 5. Some retained candidates may fail to pass the criteria in the alignment step.
Bigger values do not improve batch search speed and consume more memory. Reduce this value when memory is limited.

Function: Force garbage collection every N queries.
Comment: The value can't be too small.

It mainly affects candidate subsequence extraction. Increase this value if you have hundreds of genome batches or have multiple queries, and do not forget to set a larger `ulimit -n` in the shell if the value is > 1024.

Function: Load the whole seed data into memory for faster batch searching
Comment: Use this if the index is not big and many queries need to be searched.

Function: Print debug information, including a progress bar.
Comment: Recommended when searching with one query.
